subject: Renewal: Expand Reserved Pool & Token-rate SLO for Streamline Labs
messages:
From: Jennifer Park <jennifer@streamlinelabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@streamlinelabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal + reserved pool expansion request

Vivek —

As we approach our 12/15 renewal, Streamline Labs is planning to increase inference footprint for our search & summarization pipelines. Current usage is hitting consistent token bursts during peak hours and we want to lock in reserved capacity for predictability.

High-level ask: +6 A100 equivalent GPUs in a dedicated reserved pool, with a tokens/sec guarantee for the pool during business hours (US PST). We also want an explicit ramp schedule and remediation (service credit) language in the renewal addendum.

Can you share a draft SLO you’d be comfortable committing to alongside the pricing delta? Attaching our internal traffic sketch.

Thanks,
– Jennifer
Director, Platform Engineering
Streamline Labs

Attachments: 20261118-stream-traffic-sketch.csv (attachment stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer@streamlinelabs.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@streamlinelabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + reserved pool expansion request

Hi Jennifer —

Thanks for the context and the traffic sketch. We can definitely put together an addendum that covers: pool sizing, tokens/sec SLO for the reserved pool (business hours & 24x7 tiers), a ramp schedule, and a simple service credit formula for missed SLOs.

Proposed starting points (draft):
- Reserved pool: +6 A100-equivalent GPUs (single pool, customer-isolated)
- Pool nominal capacity guarantee: 250,000 tokens/sec (aggregate across pool) during business hours (8am–8pm PST); fallback floor of 120,000 tokens/sec for 24x7 availability
- Per-GPU guidance: assume ~42k tokens/sec sustained per A100-equivalent in this workload profile (we’ll include headroom in the pricing)
- Ramp: full pool live within 21 calendar days of execution; staged activation permitted (2 GPUs every 5 business days)
- Remediation: service credits computed as % of monthly pool fee: 10% credit if monthly p99 latency for token delivery exceeds SLO for >48 cumulative hours; 25% credit if >120 hours. Credits capped at 50% of monthly pool fee.

I’m attaching a concise term-sheet that you can circulate with procurement. If this looks close to what you expect I’ll loop Legal for formal addendum language and provide a DocuSign link.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-slo-term-sheet.xlsx (attachment stub); pool-sizing-proposal.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: pricing calc for Streamline Labs expansion

Vivek / Aditya —

Quick internal note before we send Legal/Docs:
- Using our standard Reserved Pool uplift, +6 A100 equiv = 60% uplift vs current pool spend. Proposed monthly uplift = $52k (list) with a 12-month renewal term.
- Include an option for quarterly performance review (no charge) to validate tokens/sec assumptions; if observed util deviates >20% we can propose a quantization/instance tuning plan.
- Confirm we want the staged activation language (2 GPUs/5 business days) — helps onboarding but slightly delays full revenue recognition.

If OK I’ll approve and forward to Legal for drafting the addendum.

-Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood

From: Jennifer Park <jennifer@streamlinelabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@streamlinelabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + reserved pool expansion request

Thanks, Vivek and Marissa — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from procurement:
- We need the SLO to call out measurement windows and the exact metric name ("aggregate_reserved_pool_tokens_per_sec") so internal auditors can map it to our observability.
- Can you make the business-hours guarantee apply Monday–Friday 8am–8pm PST (not weekends)? Weekends can be the lower 24x7 floor.
- Please add an optional 3-month pilot discount: if we run the staged activation and meet the business-hours SLO for the first 90 days, apply a one-time credit equal to 5% of the first quarter invoice.

If you can send a redlineable PDF, procurement will route for approval next week.

Jennifer

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer@streamlinelabs.com>, Procurement <procurement@streamlinelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final: SLO wording + next steps (redline-ready)

Jennifer / Procurement —

Per your asks I’ve updated the term-sheet and SLO language. Key changes in this draft:
- Metric name: "aggregate_reserved_pool_tokens_per_sec" (defined in section 2.1; measured from our routing layer metrics emitted to both parties)
- Business-hours guarantee: Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00 PST; weekends default to 24x7 floor (120k tokens/sec)
- Pilot credit: 5% one-time credit applied to first quarterly invoice if staged activation completes and business-hours SLO met for 90 consecutive days
- Measurement windows: SLO evaluated on a rolling 30-day window; violations counted when rolling 30-day p95 falls below the SLO for >6 hours cumulative in that window
- Service credit trigger thresholds refined: 10% credit for 12–48 cumulative hours below SLO in a calendar month; 25% for 49–120 hours; cap 50%

Next steps: 1) Procurement to confirm acceptance of measurement window & pilot credit; 2) I’ll notify Legal and deliver redline-friendly PDF + DocuSign once confirmed; 3) On execution we’ll create the reserved pool and schedule staged activation.

Links: DocuSign (https://app.redwood.com/docusign/ENVELOPE-7890) | Deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567)

If that all looks good I’ll kick Legal and Ops.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
